MartialLaw.description: Martial Law has been declared on the station, giving Security significantly more power by suspending individual rights and freedoms.

SecurityCrackdown.description: Security has launched a station-wide crackdown, increasing detentions and searches, but stretching resources thin.

SecurityCheckpoint.description: Security has set up checkpoints on the station, slowing down movement through key areas.

SecurityBudgetCut.description: Security is facing budget cuts, reducing their resource, which embolden criminal on the Station.

SecurityBudgetIncrease.description: Security has received a budget increase, causing some criminals to lay low.

ReducedPatrol.description: Security has reduced patrol coverage, leading to increased criminal activity and disorder.

ExtraPatrol.description: Security has increased patrol coverage, discouraging criminal activity and improving order.

SurveillanceUpgrade.description: New surveillance systems have been installed, improving security response times and reducing criminal activity.

EmergencyLockdown.description: An emergency lockdown has been initiated, cutting off movement and forcing order, at a heavy cost to resources.

TacticalDeployment.description: Security has deployed Emergency Response Teams, increasing security presence and maintaining order.
